title: Get this tour.  You won’t be disappointed
text: Our guide and driver David M. was exceptional! Not only was he early and waiting for us, he listened to what we wanted to see and do.  Then we saw and did those items first.  He took us to the best vantage points at each location we went to.  We got the exact pics we wanted and more.  He explained the areas and culture and food!  Showed us the best tapas spot and helped get us inside…because this place gets lines out the door.  I can’t say enough good things about this experience and David.
author: Richard_T

title: Amazing way to see the White Cities and Ronda
text: Incredible guide ---Peter was so nice and accommodating and knowledgeable--he gave us a fantastic day in this amazing area
author: Fidelma_R

title: Incredible! Ask for Guide name Peter!
text: I don’t even know where to begin! This was incredible! Highlight of our vacation so far. Ronda might be our favorite place in Spain so far and Setenil is a MUST see! White Villages are cool for me, but you don’t need to see them and I can see how some people are a bit bored with that part. Keep in mind this is a PRIVATE tour, so you get out of it what you put into it. It’s just your group and the guide, who is also the driver. Ask a lot of questions, learn about the Guide (ours - Peter - was fantastic!). Worth every penny and then some. Make sure you tell them what you want.
author: Wolfgang_M

title: We took a walk through...
text:
We made the tour of the Pueblos Blancos, including Ronda and Setenil de las Bodegas, and we had an excellent experience! Our guide, David, was extremely attentive, polite and professional throughout the day.

In addition to driving with a lot of safety and tranquility, David gave us very interesting explanations throughout the route, sharing information about the history, culture and curiosities of the places we visited. Always available and careful, made the ride even more enjoyable.

Ronda and Setenil are amazing places and the script is well worth it. We had a wonderful day. Excellent exper
author: Gabriella_A

title: A full and beautiful day!
text: While staying in Seville, we decided to take a day trip to Ronda and the White Villages. After looking at several group tours (priced at about $100 per person), we opted to go with a private tour with Naturanda (about $200 per person). With only a day to explore this region, we did not want to be on a large tour with up to 30 people. We made the right decision. Our guide, Laura picked us up at our hotel in Seville promptly at 9am.
